connectionSpecification.description: Reads project configuration, customers with their subscriptions, purchases and active entitlements, and overview metrics from the RevenueCat REST API v2 with a v2 secret API key.

api_key.description: A RevenueCat secret API key of version V2 (Project settings > API keys). It is sent in the Authorization header. API v1 keys do not work with REST API v2. See the README for the read permissions each stream needs.
api_key.title: Secret API Key (v2)

environment.description: Store environment of the customer subscriptions and purchases to read: sandbox or production. Leave empty to read both.
environment.title: Environment

project_id.description: ID of the RevenueCat project to read. Leave empty when the key can see exactly one project.
project_id.title: Project ID

connectionSpecification.title: RevenueCat Source Spec
